en.askTitle: Enter your own city, date and cash ceiling and get a shortlist checked the same way
en.runTitle: Phoenix: a reliable used car for a commuter, all-in budget $15,000

fields.label: Cash ceiling
fields.value: USD 15,000 all-in, including tax, title and registration

fields.label: Repair reserve
fields.placeholder: e.g. $1,500 kept aside for repairs in the first year

en.template: Help me shortlist used cars in {city} for {date}, with {cash} and {mileage}. Separate acquisition fees from running costs, check dated local ads and vehicle-specific warnings, and keep {reserve} available. Give me an inspection and paperwork checklist; do not contact sellers, apply for credit, reserve or buy anything.

phases.title: Re-check the listings, recalls and official cost sources
phases.note: Earlier notes were treated as leads and checked again
phases.judgment: Notes left by an earlier attempt were not taken on trust: the researcher reopened all six Corolla and Mazda3 listings, dated November 5, 2026, and re-verified that Toyota’s later CVT service campaign replaces the earlier one.

phases.title: Build the decision report, cost table and buying checklist
phases.note: Four model targets, twelve inspected ads, fuel and recall notes
phases.judgment: A researcher first reported “Partial—not six verified usable listings” for the Fit and CR-V, rather than padding the list; a follow-up round then closed the gap with six inspected ads. Along the way one CR-V with 26,118 miles was excluded because the same VIN appears in a salvage-auction history, pending a title check, and a Fit with conflicting prices was labelled an unverified lead.

phases.title: Check the final page once and hand over the files

workers: Reopened six Phoenix-area Corolla and Mazda3 listings to re-check price, mileage and location, then checked recall campaigns and fuel economy
Inspected Phoenix-area Honda Fit and CR-V listings and checked recalls, official fuel economy and manufacturer bulletins for those years

fields.value: 含税费、过户和注册，总共 15,000 美元

zh.template: 请帮我筛选{city}、{date}的二手车，现金上限{cash}，年里程{mileage}。分开购入费用和日常用车成本，比较带日期的本地广告及单车风险，保留{reserve}。给我验车和文件清单；不要联系卖家、申请贷款、预留或购买。

phases.title: 复核在售广告、召回信息和官方费用来源
phases.note: 之前留下的笔记只当线索，重新核对
phases.judgment: 上一次中断时留下的笔记没有直接采信：同事重新打开了卡罗拉和马自达 3 共六条广告，日期为 2026 年 11 月 5 日，并重新确认丰田后来的 CVT 服务活动取代了更早的那一项。

phases.title: 制作决策报告、费用表和购车清单
phases.note: 四个车型目标、十二条已逐条查看的广告、油耗和召回说明
phases.judgment: 有同事先如实汇报飞度和 CR-V “只完成了一部分，没有六条可用的已核实广告”，没有凑数；之后补了一轮，才补齐六条已逐条查看的广告。其中一台行驶 26,118 英里的 CR-V 因同一车架号出现在拍卖的报废记录里，在查清产权前被排除；一台价格互相矛盾的飞度只标为未核实的线索。

phases.title: 最后检查一次页面，交付文件
